gbm_population_evidence.quote: Primary Malignant Brain Tumor; Glioblastoma (GBM); Astrocytoma; Oligodendroglioma; Caregiver
Self-report a diagnosis of a primary malignant brain tumor (grade II-IV)

candidate_evidence.quote: FearLess is a newly developed, empirically-rooted, manualized psychological intervention consisting of an intake + 8 sessions delivered over a 12-week time period.

coder_notes: Behavioural psychological intervention (fear of cancer recurrence) for brain tumour patients and caregivers; no drug or biologic interventions, so no agents and no pharmacological candidate. Phase NA. The OTHER-labelled 'FearLess Delayed Control Arm' is a waitlist control, so control_arm_from_other_arms is yes. Glioblastoma is named in conditions among other gliomas; eligibility relies on self-reported grade II-IV primary malignant brain tumour. Treatment setting not specified.
